name: Coca-Cola
hook: The Atlanta pharmacy drink that became the world's most recognizable brand.

facts.label: John Pemberton
facts.statement: Atlanta pharmacist John Pemberton created Coca-Cola in 1886; the company is still headquartered in Atlanta.

facts.label: Spencerian script
facts.statement: Bookkeeper Frank Robinson named the drink and wrote its Spencerian-script logo; the trademark was registered in 1893.

facts.label: Asa Candler
facts.statement: Asa Candler, elected mayor of Atlanta in 1916, gave control of Coca-Cola to his children.

facts.label: Sprite and Fanta
facts.statement: Sprite, the lemon-lime soda, arrived in 1961; Fanta's original orange version was formulated in Germany during World War II.

facts.label: Tab
facts.statement: Tab was Coca-Cola's first diet soda and the leading U.S. diet drink until Diet Coke arrived in 1982.

facts.label: I'd Like to Teach the World to Sing
facts.statement: The Hillside Singers had a hit with "I'd Like to Teach the World to Sing," adapted from a Coca-Cola commercial jingle.
associations: I'd Like to Teach the World to Sing

facts.label: Andy Warhol
facts.statement: Andy Warhol's 1962 Green Coca-Cola Bottles hangs in the Whitney; another of his Coke-bottle paintings sold for over $57 million in 2013.
